measured_by: re-measurement on disk (find/ls/lzma-decode/pandas); no numbers copied from prior docs
corpus_digest_strategy: sha256 over the newline-joined sorted list of 'filename,size' lines for every file in the panel side directory (order-independent, no bulk reads; changes on any add/remove/resize). Content-level identity additionally available via per-file sha256 manifests (fxm.m1_manifest@1) staged next to each M1 corpus.

USDCAD.provenance_note: staged by cycle ERP1-TRACKA-COHORT-1 from the same Dukascopy M1 feed (duka manifest window 2021-01-01..2026-06-30, 4014 files, 0 days missing; raw M1 .bi5 not retained in this worktree - only the derived H1 plane)
USDCAD.first_last_method: min/max of parquet ts column (source stamps are OPEN-time; loaders.shift +1h to close-time)

columns_spec.ts: datetime64[ms, UTC], open-stamped hour bars (loader converts to close-stamp)
columns_spec.b_o b_h b_l b_c: bid open/high/low/close (H/L follow ancestor convention: max/min of M1 closes, NOT intrabar extremes)
columns_spec.a_o a_c: ask open/close (no ask H/L in source)
columns_spec.s_open s_close: spread at open / close (ask-bid, price units)

USDCAD.timezone_evidence: ts dtype is tz-aware UTC; Sunday rows appear at 22:00/23:00 UTC (FX weekly open), consistent with the UTC M1 source feed

gaps.note: structural, not data loss: panel contains only tradable hours (vol>0, price band, ask>=bid, consecutive minutes). Saturdays absent (0 rows), ~21:00-22:00 UTC rollover hour mostly absent, weekday median 21 rows/day; largest gaps are holiday weekends (e.g. 2021-01-08 22:00 -> 2021-01-10 21:00, 48h)

macro_inputs.note: no fredgraph CSV or NY Fed EFFR JSON files exist in the repo/worktrees yet (searched). loaders.load_macro_series implements both parsers (fredgraph_csv: observation_date,<SERIES>, '.'=missing; nyfed_effr_json: effectiveDate/percentRate/revisionIndicator, list or {refRates:[...]}) and is covered by synthetic fixtures; stage the real files before the macro lane runs.

loader_layer.stamp_convention: all bars close-stamped UTC: bar labeled T aggregates (T-rule, T]; at decision time T every bar stamped <=T is complete (no lookahead by construction)
loader_layer.anc_conversion: source ANC parquets are open-stamped; load_fx_h1 shifts +1h to the close convention and documents the ancestor H/L caveat

cross_measurement.note: measure_panels.py (prior interrupted I1a attempt, reviewed + units bug fixed) independently re-measures all panels -> measured_panels.json; all overlapping numbers agree with this manifest (counts, bytes, ts ranges, H1 sha256, manifest hashes)
cross_measurement.digest_difference: manifest digests are per-side filename,size; measured_panels.json uses combined-side side/filename size; both documented
